description.value: Peach Creek Spawning Channels is a nature reserve in Chilliwack where visitors can observe salmon returning to spawn. It is listed within the City of Chilliwack's parks and trails system and sits near the Lickman Road area. For touring cyclists, it offers a chance to experience BC's wild salmon lifecycle up close during migration season.
